v.n: Transformers: EarthSpark | Season 3: The FULL Story Recap…

eps.o: Half of Witwicky is trapped under the Prime Dome. Robby wishes life would go back to normal, so Mo, Thrash, and Bumblebee team up to lift Robby's spirits and rescue what's stuck inside the chaotic Dome – but Bee has an ulterior motive…

Robby invites Izzy to a drive-in movie, so all the Maltos tag along and go to extreme lengths to make it the best night ever – but their help transforms the movie's science fiction into science reality…
Robby, Mo, and the Terrans are invited to play Witwicky's new Escape Room game. Twitch loves to win, so she's eager to help her team succeed – but the game is much more than meets the eye…
An Autobot starship crash lands on Earth! The Autobots and Maltos must get there first to protect it – and whomever is inside – from the Decepticons…
The Maltos enjoy a snow day while, back at Base, something has the Autobots in a red-hot rage… When Twitch gets caught in their frenzy – can she survive long enough to help her troubled friends?

Prowl, Thrash, and Robby team up to solve the mystery of who is behind the recent attack on the Autobots. Thrash gets to flex his detective skills, and Robby finds evidence that’s out of this world… Will they find the culprit before the next attack?

On the worst day of Robby's life, he and Mo must fight for their lives against a new Invader who claims to be the rightful heir to Quintus Prime's power. The only way the Maltos and the Autobots can help is by putting their trust in unlikely allies…
